name: Vertical AI GTM rivals (Owner, Trenz, Restomas, Feedia)
what_it_does: Agentic stacks for restaurants/social commerce: Owner (direct order + AI marketing vs DoorDash rent), Trenz (TikTok Shop agent team), Restomas (full marketing/guest agents), Feedia (indie social agent squad).
how_competitors_use_it: They sell approve-then-execute marketing/social/commerce agents to independents — same anti-marketplace story, different wedge than Never86 chef-love buy-now + pain shopping.
what_we_use_today: Restaurant Scout + 238 pain shoppers + teach loop + shoppable scripts; Cursor/Grok Bot agent ops.
gap: Need continuous vertical competitor tracking (not forecasting tools) and sharper public wedges like graders.
summary: Best-in-vertical race is agent depth on social commerce + operator GTM — stay Cursor-powered, copy wedge patterns (grader/inbound) carefully, do not chase sales/labor forecasting suites.
